text:
rachel_t: Pushed a docs PR that focuses on embedding metering + tiered pricing examples and how that shows up in the usage dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/3120

peter_v: Nice. Can you include both a public grafana snapshot and a small curl/python snippet showing how to set the consumption attribution? People keep asking how to show embeddings cost separately from text gen.

rachel_t: added public snapshot link: https://grafana.public/redwood/snapshot/embeddings-tier-2026 (kept internal grafana link for staff only). Also added an explanation of how embedding units map to billing: 1 embedding unit = 1 vector encode call (rounded per request) and a short table of example costs (ballpark).

hao_m: small nit on header names: our billing pipeline expects `x-redwood-quota-tenant` for quota attribution and `x-redwood-consumption-type` for distinguishing embeddings vs tokens. Docs should show lowercase headers and note only service tokens can set these.\

rachel_t: updated examples. added curl + python SDKv5 snippet: 

```bash
# curl example to attribute to a team and mark consumption type as embeddings
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \n  -H "x-redwood-quota-tenant: team:research" \n  -H "x-redwood-consumption-type: embeddings" \n  -d '{"model":"embed-open-1","input":"The quick brown fox"}'
```

```py
# python SDKv5 example (illustrative)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['SERVICE_TOKEN'])
resp = client.embeddings.create(
  model='embed-open-1',
  input=['doc1', 'doc2'],
  headers={
    'x-redwood-quota-tenant': 'team:research',
    'x-redwood-consumption-type': 'embeddings'
  }
)
print(resp)
```

peter_v: perfect. also add a tiny section explaining the cost panel: cost-by-consumption-type (embeddings vs generation) and a sample annotated caption showing a tier cutover: "Free -> Pro at 2026-03-05T10:12Z, embeddings spike as backlog drains".

rachel_t: added the caption and recommended snapshot annotation guidance. Mentioned to avoid hard numbers for public pages and link to the cost estimator spreadsheet for teams that need concrete math.

hao_m: what about Dedicated pools? They sometimes return `x-redwood-dedicated-rate-*` headers and have different per-unit economics. Add a 1-line note and link to Dedicated pricing page.

rachel_t: added note: "Dedicated pools may expose per-customer rate headers (X-Redwood-Dedicated-Rate-*) — consult account admin or the Dedicated pricing doc."

billing-bot: reminder: please include billing migration FAQ if doc mentions tier changes; legacy accounts can have grace windows up to 72h.

rachel_t: good catch — added short FAQ: "Do quotas and pricing change immediately after a tier update?" Answer: usually immediate for new accounts, but migrations and legacy grace windows may delay changes; link to billing migration playbook.

docs-bot: lint check failed on PR #3120: long line in python snippet.

rachel_t: fixed formatting and wrapped long lines. re-pushed.

docs-bot: docs PR #3120 passed CI 8 checks, 0 failures9.

peter_v: approved. tiny editorial nit: in the cost examples use "estimate" callouts so readers don't treat numbers as guarantees.

rachel_t: updated wording to use "estimate" and added a short link to Optimize guide for quantization and batching effects on embedding throughput/cost. merging after one more quick spellcheck.

hao_m: LGTM. thanks for the clear snippets — should help support triage when customers ask why embeddings show up in a different panel.

rachel_t: will follow up to create a public grafana snapshot for the learn page and open a small follow-up PR to add a step-by-step checklist for creating snapshots. merging now :shipit:
